subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher said, 'Before replacing something, first understand what is wrong.'”?
options: Some showed that many students did not understand the same idea.
Before every test, Nora used the same yellow pencil.
Later, students used the same idea in other situations.
Later, other students shared their family foods too.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some showed that many students did not understand the same idea.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Before every test, Nora used the same yellow pencil.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The teacher said, 'Before replacing something, first understand what is wrong.' Later, students used the same idea in other situations.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Later, other students shared their family foods too.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The teacher said, 'Before replacing something, first understand what is wrong.' Later, students used the same idea in other situations.」，答案為「Later, students used the same idea in other situations.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Later, students used the same idea in other situations.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
